greeting: Village Healer Spring on comms. Stage 4: The Warmth Within. Keep formation tight and decisions tighter.
We are running The Frozen Path. Objective drift gets teams buried.
I met my future self and we argued about shoe durability.
Action first, panic never. Start with: Reach Whitehollow village.
dialog.quest_hook: Objective stack: Reach Whitehollow village; Use the Crystals to break the Void storm; Protect the villagers. Keep route integrity while pressure escalates.
dialog.quest_active: Active pressure: Help a Frostfolk village survive a Void-touched blizzard. Immediate move: Reach Whitehollow village.
dialog.quest_complete: Stage 4 resolved: The Warmth Within. Primary objective secured and route stabilized. Prepare for Echoes of the Before.
rumor: Villagers report hearing a lullaby inside frozen walls.
People keep repeating one clue from The Warmth Within: 'Protect the villagers'.
Yesterday a corridor tried to charge me toll in riddles. I paid in sarcasm.
dialog.time_dawn: Dawn gives hard snow and readable tracks. Best time to cross open ground.
dialog.time_noon: Noon glare can blind you faster than a storm. Shade your optics.
dialog.time_dusk: Dusk fog rises from cracked ice. Ropes out, spacing tight.
dialog.time_night: Night cold punishes hesitation. Rotate watch and check each other for frostbite.

party_reactions.kade: Village Healer Spring sounds intense, but the plan is solid. We keep moving.
party_reactions.nix7: Tactical profile for Village Healer Spring accepted. Probability of success improves with compliance.
party_reactions.twist: Village Healer Spring talks scary, but I like it. We punch the problem and then celebrate.

relationship_dialog.stranger: State your objective in one sentence.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Welcome back. What changed since last pass?
relationship_dialog.friend: Good. We move cleaner when we move together.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: No masks, no theater, just us and the objective.
